exercises.question: Draw the structural formula of propane (C3H8).
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Propane has 3 carbon atoms (n=3).\n2. Arrange 3 C atoms in a single-bonded chain.\n3. Fill valence electrons with 8 Hydrogen atoms.
